module Intro.Asset where

data SplitResult = SplitResult with
  splitAsset : ContractId Asset
  remainder : ContractId Asset
    deriving (Eq, Show)

-- ASSET_BEGIN
template Asset
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
    symbol : Text
    quantity : Decimal
    observers : [Party]
  where
    signatory issuer, owner
    ensure quantity > 0.0

    observer observers
-- ASSET_END


-- MERGE_SPLIT_BEGIN
    choice Split
      : SplitResult
      with
        splitQuantity : Decimal
      controller owner
      do
        splitAsset <- create this with
          quantity = splitQuantity
        remainder <- create this with
          quantity = quantity - splitQuantity
        return SplitResult with
          splitAsset
          remainder

    choice Merge
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        otherCid : ContractId Asset
      controller owner
      do
        other <- fetch otherCid
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: issuer does not match"
          (issuer == other.issuer)
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: owner does not match"
          (owner == other.owner)
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: symbol does not match"
          (symbol == other.symbol)
        archive otherCid
        create this with
          quantity = quantity + other.quantity
-- MERGE_SPLIT_END

    choice ProposeTransfer
      : ContractId TransferProposal
      with
        newOwner : Party
      controller owner
      do
        create TransferProposal with
          asset = this
          newOwner

    choice  SetObservers
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        newObservers : [Party]
      controller owner
      do
        create this with
          observers = newObservers

template TransferProposal
  with
    asset : Asset
    newOwner : Party
  where
    signatory (signatory asset)
    observer newOwner

    choice TransferProposal_Accept
        : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.issuer, newOwner
        do
          create asset with
            owner = newOwner

    choice TransferProposal_Cancel
        : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.owner
        do
          create asset with
            observers = []

    choice TransferProposal_Reject
        : ContractId Asset
        controller newOwner
        do
          create asset

template TransferApproval
  with
    asset : Asset
    newOwner : Party
  where
    signatory asset.issuer
    observer asset.owner, newOwner

    choice TransferApproval_Cancel
        : ()
        controller asset.owner
        do
          return ()

    choice TransferApproval_Reject
        : ()
        controller newOwner
        do
          return ()

    choice TransferApproval_Transfer
        : ContractId Asset
        with
          assetCid : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.owner, newOwner
        do
          sentAsset <- fetch assetCid
          assertMsg
            "Transfer failed: Assets do not match."
            (asset == sentAsset with
              observers = asset.observers
            )
          archive assetCid
          create asset with
            owner = newOwner
            observers = []

    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with

module Test.Intro.Asset.Role where

import Daml.Script
import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

test_issuance = do
  alice <- allocateParty \"Alice\"
  bob <- allocateParty \"Bob\"
  bank <- allocateParty \"USD_Bank\"

  submitMustFail alice do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = bank
      owner = alice

  inviteAlice <- submit bank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = bank
      owner = alice
  inviteBob <- submit bank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = bank
      owner = bob

  Some invitation <- queryContractId alice inviteAlice
  assert (invitation.issuer == bank && invitation.owner == alice)

  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd inviteAlice AssetHolderInvite_Accept
  submitMustFail bank do
    exerciseCmd inviteAlice AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  holderAlice <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd inviteAlice AssetHolderInvite_Accept
  holderBob <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd inviteBob AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  Some holder <- queryContractId bank holderAlice
  assert (holder.issuer == bank && holder.owner == alice)
  Some bobHolder <- queryContractId bob holderBob
  assert (bobHolder.issuer == bank && bobHolder.owner == bob)
  expiredInvite <- queryContractId bank inviteAlice
  assert (expiredInvite == None)
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd inviteAlice AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Issue_Asset with
      symbol = \"USD\"
      quantity = 100.0
  submitMustFail bank do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Issue_Asset with
      symbol = \"USD\"
      quantity = 0.0
  submitMustFail bank do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Issue_Asset with
      symbol = \"USD\"
      quantity = -1.0

  assetCid <- submit bank do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Issue_Asset with
      symbol = \"USD\"
      quantity = 100.0
  Some asset <- queryContractId alice assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
    issuer = bank
    owner = alice
    symbol = \"USD\"
    quantity = 100.0
    observers = [])
  return ((alice, bob, bank, holderAlice, holderBob), assetCid)

test_repeat_issuance = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, holderAlice, holderBob), firstCid) <- test_issuance
  secondCid <- submit bank do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Issue_Asset with
      symbol = \"EUR\"
      quantity = 0.5
  Some first <- queryContractId bank firstCid
  Some second <- queryContractId bank secondCid
  assert (first.quantity == 100.0)
  assert (second == Asset with
    issuer = bank
    owner = alice
    symbol = \"EUR\"
    quantity = 0.5
    observers = [])

test_holder_accept_transfer = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, holderAlice, holderBob), assetCid) <- test_issuance
  proposalCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid ProposeTransfer with
      newOwner = bob

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = proposalCid
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd holderBob Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = proposalCid

  receivedCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd holderBob Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = proposalCid
  Some received <- queryContractId bank receivedCid
  assert (received == Asset with
    issuer = bank
    owner = bob
    symbol = \"USD\"
    quantity = 100.0
    observers = [])
  assert (receivedCid /= assetCid)
  previous <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (previous == None)
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd holderBob Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = proposalCid

  proposalBack <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd receivedCid ProposeTransfer with
      newOwner = alice
  returnedCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = proposalBack
  Some returned <- queryContractId bank returnedCid
  assert (returned.owner == alice && returned.issuer == bank)

test_holder_cannot_accept_other_issuers_transfer = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, holderAlice, holderBob), assetCid) <- test_issuance
  otherBank <- allocateParty \"Other_Bank\"
  otherInvite <- submit otherBank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = otherBank
      owner = bob
  otherHolder <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd otherInvite AssetHolderInvite_Accept
  proposalCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid ProposeTransfer with
      newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd otherHolder Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = proposalCid
  receivedCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd holderBob Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = proposalCid
  Some received <- queryContractId bank receivedCid
  assert (received.owner == bob && received.issuer == bank)

test_preapprove_transfer = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, holderAlice, holderBob), assetCid) <- test_issuance
  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset
  approvalAlice <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd holderAlice Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset
  Some approval <- queryContractId bank approvalAlice
  assert (approval.asset == asset && approval.newOwner == alice)

  observedCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid SetObservers with
      newObservers = [bob]
  Some observedAsset <- queryContractId bank observedCid
  approvalBob <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd holderBob Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = observedAsset
  Some bobApproval <- queryContractId bank approvalBob
  assert (bobApproval.asset == observedAsset && bobApproval.newOwner == bob)
  approvalBobAgain <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd holderBob Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = observedAsset
  Some stillActive <- queryContractId bank approvalBob
  Some secondApproval <- queryContractId bank approvalBobAgain
  assert (stillActive.asset == secondApproval.asset)
  assert (secondApproval.newOwner == bob)
